findings.claim: Accept parsing treats raw-looking text inside a quoted parameter as a real raw media range.
findings.evidence: For Accept: application/json; profile="foo,application/vnd.github.raw+json,bar", GitHub returned JSON and the built emulator returned raw README bytes.
findings.path: Accept header -> split comma -> acceptsRawContent -> raw response branch

exemptions.claim: Generic emulate skill and landing docs need no raw media statement
exemptions.evidence: They document startup and configuration only; GitHub endpoint semantics live on the five changed service surfaces.

exemptions.claim: The package README em dash is not a style defect
exemptions.evidence: Repository AGENTS.md requires an em dash when prose punctuation needs a dash.

exemptions.claim: Exact negotiated raw Content-Type echo is not required
exemptions.evidence: GitHub's documented property is raw file contents; the PR claims exact bytes and common consumers use the body.
